# opnsense_crowdsec_settings (Data Source)

Reads CrowdSec plugin general settings from the upstream system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_crowdsec_settings" "current" {}

output "crowdsec_agent_enabled" {
  value = data.opnsense_crowdsec_settings.current.agent_enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `agent_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the CrowdSec agent (log processor / IDS) is enabled.
- `crowdsec_firewall_verbose` (Boolean) Whether verbose logging is written to the firewall bouncer log.
- `enroll_key` (String, Sensitive) Enrollment key from https://app.crowdsec.net.
- `firewall_bouncer_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the remediation component (IPS / firewall bouncer) is enabled.
- `id` (String) Always set to `crowdsec_settings`.
- `lapi_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the CrowdSec Local API (LAPI) is enabled.
- `lapi_listen_address` (String) IP address the LAPI listens on.
- `lapi_listen_port` (String) Port the LAPI listens on.
- `lapi_manual_configuration` (Boolean) Whether manual LAPI configuration is enabled, avoiding overwrites of config.yaml, local_api_credentials.yaml, and crowdsec-firewall-bouncer.yaml.
- `rules_enabled` (Boolean) Whether block rules are generated from the CrowdSec blocklists.
- `rules_log` (Boolean) Whether log collection is enabled for CrowdSec's block rules.
- `rules_tag` (String) Tag added to packets dropped by CrowdSec rules.
